# WACK schema fixture

`windows-app-certification-kit-10.0.26100.7705.xml` is a synthetic minimum
fixture shaped from reviewed reflection of the local
`Microsoft.Windows.SoftwareLogo.Shared.dll` file version `10.0.26100.7705`.
No real WACK run report was available.

The application values are synthetic. The meaning of the WACK `ID` attribute
is unverified and must not be treated as a Microsoft Store Identity Name.
